Cooler Water. Better Summer Sips.

Warm weather can make water less inviting. ChillSip Cooling Bowl by Tilting Heads is designed to help keep drinking water cooler for longer, encouraging pets to stay hydrated during hot days.

Why ChillSip?

Freezable Gel Core — helps keep water cooler for longer periods
Pet-Safe Design — made for everyday hydration routines
Easy Fill & Freeze — simple cooling preparation before use
Stable Drinking Bowl — designed for daily use at home
Summer Hydration Support — helps make water more refreshing on hot days

From warm afternoons to peak summer days, ChillSip Cooling Bowl helps make hydration feel cooler, fresher, and more inviting.

Available for dogs and cats. Ideal for everyday summer hydration.
